purpose: Read-only release metadata synchronization for the expanded 149-entry watchlist; no firmware binary download or execution in this synchronization.

command.notes: The exact retained harness was originally run from a temporary directory. Argument paths are intentionally normalized. It invokes the existing release synchronizer, catalog updater and download metadata resolver; proposed outputs were reviewed before applying.

metadataFilter.semantics: Preserve latest release identity, date and original asset count; retain only the anchored board-and-panel filename subset. Never creates an automatic update target or a compatibility claim.

timestampPolicy: A successful unchanged observation checked again within one day retains its prior checkedAt. Current request timestamps are recorded separately above. Failed requests retain prior data and attemptedAt; this audit does not assert that every upstream supplied a current release.

replay.mode: Replay of the exact recorded HTTP response bodies, not a second live network observation

sourceMappingReview.manifestIdentityRule: manifest.board equals the explicitly sourced product.runtime.board; shared firmwareTargetId does not inherit factory identity, execution verification, or hardware validation.

separateMeshtasticRecovery.auditClassification: One independently pinned official recovery image, additional to the 32 factory-image-pinned products. It does not upgrade the factory reference to an exact manufacturing-batch image.

openPullRequestCheck.bodyReceipt: Connector result only; no original HTTP byte/hash receipt is asserted. An earlier unauthenticated HTTP 403 was not treated as an empty pull-request list.

privacy.retained: Normalized release snapshot, public endpoint URLs, HTTP status, UTC, original response byte counts and SHA-256; no raw API response bodies.
privacy.omitted: Raw response authors, emails, avatars and uploader records; local paths and temporary signed URL queries.
privacy.hashSemantics: HTTP body hashes describe original bytes before normalization. No normalized extraction is presented as the original HTTP response.
privacy.manualReview: The 42 staged paths were scanned for literal local user paths, source author/email/avatar/uploader fields and signed URL credentials; no matches. The normalized release fields and all new source references were reviewed.

checkLog.redaction: Only normalized command arguments were added; test output was preserved without device or user identities.
